items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: as a chaplain my grandfather Bill

ctx.x: And I'm not looking for that, but I saw Howlin’ Wolf transmission was so direct that they had to have that right then. But, I do know the spirit is strong and you asked me earlier about the spirituals. Well when my grandmother took me down to the church as a child, as a chaplain my grandfather Bill, that those spirituals man... What was I gonna ask you honey? What did Higgins say to me, what was it back there?
What was the, I'm trying to remember exactly, it was something that he said to you near his deathbed?
